acid-splash.summary: A 5-foot-radius Sphere explodes: creatures make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 1d6 Acid damage on a failure.
elementalism.summary: Create one minor effect within range: a breeze, dust or sand, harmless embers and smoke, mist or water, or a crude shape.
mending.summary: Repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch, up to 1 foot in any dimension; can't restore magic to magic items.
produce-flame.summary: A flame in your hand sheds Bright Light 20 feet. Magic action: ranged spell attack within 60 feet, 1d8 Fire damage.
shocking-grasp.summary: Melee spell attack: 1d8 Lightning damage; the target can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.
alarm.summary: Wards a door, window or area up to a 20-foot Cube: an audible or mental alarm alerts you when a creature touches or enters.
comprehend-languages.summary: Understand spoken and signed languages, and written languages while touching the surface; 1 minute per page of text.
ensnaring-strike.summary: Target makes a Strength save; failure means Restrained (1d6 Piercing damage each turn) until spell ends; success ends the spell.
grease.summary: Creates Difficult Terrain in a 10-foot square: creatures must make a Dexterity saving throw or fall Prone.
acid-arrow.summary: Ranged spell attack: 4d4 Acid damage, then 2d4 Acid damage at the end of its next turn; on a miss, half initial damage.
calm-emotions.summary: Charisma save for each Humanoid in a 20-foot-radius Sphere; on a failure, Immunity to Charmed and Frightened or Indifferent.
flame-blade.summary: Evoke a fiery blade: melee spell attack deals 3d6 Fire damage plus your spellcasting ability modifier.
